title: VS Code Agent Skills
summary: Personal skills may be placed in ~/.copilot/skills/. Instructions are loaded on demand. Discovery does not guarantee invocation; support depends on the agent harness.

title: Workbooks.Open
summary: Returns the opened Workbook. Explicitly choose link updates and read-only mode. Programmatic opening requires an explicit macro-security policy.

title: Application.AutomationSecurity
summary: ForceDisable controls macros in programmatically opened files but does not disable Excel 4.0 macros. DisplayAlerts does not suppress security warnings. Capture and restore the prior security state.

title: Worksheet.Change
summary: Target can contain multiple cells. Recalculation changes do not trigger this event; use Calculate for recalculation-specific work.

title: Range.Find
summary: Returns Nothing when no match exists. Several search options persist between calls and the Find dialog; specify them explicitly. Handle wraparound in repeated searches.

title: Range.Value2
summary: Value2 does not use the Currency or Date subtypes; those values can be exposed as Double. It is not a formatting or locale parser.

title: Range.Value
summary: Multi-cell first-area reads return a two-dimensional Variant array. Multi-area array assignment is not properly supported. Size the destination to the array.

title: Application.ThisWorkbook
summary: Identifies the workbook containing the running macro. It is not an external COM-client workbook selector. Add-in code and the active user workbook may differ.

title: Application.ActiveWorkbook
summary: Identifies the workbook in the active window and can be Nothing. Protected View has separate access semantics.

title: Range.Formula2
summary: Uses array-evaluation semantics and may spill. Formula remains for backward compatibility. Confirm the target Excel supports dynamic arrays.

title: ListObject.DataBodyRange
summary: Identifies the table data range excluding its header. The skill additionally requires a defensive Nothing check for empty-table workflows.

title: Application.DisplayAlerts
summary: Suppresses selected prompts, not security. SaveAs may overwrite without confirmation. Cross-process callers must restore state explicitly.

title: On Error statement
summary: Distinguish enabled from actively handling error handlers. An error inside an active handler propagates to its caller. Resume Next must have a narrow justified scope.

title: Resume statement
summary: Resume retries the failing statement, Resume Next continues after it, and Resume label resumes at a local label. It requires an active error context.

title: Debug.Assert
summary: Suspends execution when its expression is False. The whole boolean expression is evaluated; do not use it instead of production validation.

title: Debug menu
summary: Describes Compile, watch commands, breakpoints and stepping. Compile is a VBE operation, not equivalent to a text linter.

title: Debug toolbar
summary: Provides Run, Break, Reset, stepping and diagnostic windows. Reset clears the stack and module state.

title: Set and clear a breakpoint
summary: Use F9 to stop at a statement and Ctrl+Shift+F9 to clear all breakpoints. Breakpoints are not persisted with saved code.

title: Stop code execution
summary: Distinguishes break mode from Reset and describes runtime errors, Stop, End and watch-triggered breaks.

title: Trace code execution
summary: Step Into enters callees; Step Over executes the call; Step Out completes the current procedure; Run to Cursor continues to a chosen statement.

title: Use the Immediate window
summary: Ctrl+G opens Immediate. Commands execute in a module context and can mutate state; inspect values before using assignments or procedure calls.

title: Elements of run-time error handling (Access)
summary: Supplementary explanation of error-handling flow. Transfer only language-level ideas; Access-specific object behavior is not an Excel contract.

title: Add a watch expression
summary: Define a watch and choose the narrowest relevant procedure/module context. Broad evaluation can slow execution.

title: Edit a watch expression
summary: Edit the expression, scope and watch type in the Watch window.

title: Delete a watch expression
summary: Remove an obsolete watch from the Watch window.

title: Use Quick Watch
summary: Inspect a selected expression in break mode using Shift+F9 and optionally promote it to a watch.

title: UserForm object
summary: UserForms represent loaded dialog instances. Multiple explicit instances may be created; controls are exposed through Controls.

title: Initialize event
summary: Occurs after loading an object and before it is shown; use for initial preparation rather than repeated business actions.

title: Activate and Deactivate events
summary: Activation concerns visible active windows within the application. It is not a one-time constructor, and unloading does not produce Deactivate.

title: QueryClose event
summary: CloseMode identifies control-menu close, code unload and other close causes. Cancel can prevent closing; avoid blocking application shutdown accidentally.

title: Hide method
summary: Hides without unloading; hidden controls remain accessible programmatically. Hiding an unloaded form can load it.

title: Unload statement
summary: Unloads the form. Read a modal dialog result before unloading, rather than re-accessing a default instance afterward.

title: Show method
summary: Supports modal and modeless display. Show loads an unloaded form. Code after modeless Show continues immediately.

title: Add method (Microsoft Forms)
summary: Adds tabs/pages or creates controls with a registered ProgID. Event wiring and ownership are separate engineering responsibilities.

title: Controls collection
summary: Access controls by their names or zero-based collection indexes; enumerate each relevant container instead of equating index with tab order.

title: TabIndex property
summary: Defines tab order, starting at zero. Verify focus order in the real form and its containers.

title: MultiPage control
summary: Hosts a Pages collection; Value identifies the active page. Use distinct pages for groups of controls.

title: TabStrip control
summary: Hosts Tabs and exposes SelectedItem. Switching a tab can select different data for shared controls; it is not a MultiPage replacement by name alone.

title: 64-bit VBA overview
summary: PtrSafe alone does not fix truncated handles. Use LongPtr for pointers/handles and review UDTs and assignments; Long remains 32-bit.

title: Excel performance obstructions
summary: Reduce unnecessary UI updates and worksheet/VBA transfers. Capture original application settings and restore them after work. Measure actual workloads.

title: ChartObjects.Add
summary: Creates an embedded ChartObject. Position and dimensions use points, not pixels.

title: Chart.SetSourceData
summary: Sets chart source from an explicit Range with optional row/column plotting orientation.

title: SeriesCollection.NewSeries
summary: Creates a Series for supported charts; it is not available for PivotChart reports.

title: Chart.Export
summary: Exports using an installed graphic filter and returns Boolean. Check both result and the expected file instead of assuming export succeeded.

title: Workbook.RefreshAll
summary: Refresh may run in the background. The current page also warns that a failing Power Query table refresh can leave old data without RefreshAll raising a runtime error.

title: QueryTable.Refresh
summary: Refreshes external data; BackgroundQuery=False makes supported SQL-query refresh synchronous. Missing connection details can produce dialogs or failures.

title: PivotCaches.Create
summary: Creates a PivotCache from a supported source type. Explicit source strings/names can avoid unexpected type-mismatch issues. xlPivotTableVersionCurrent is not accepted.

title: Application.Quit
summary: Quits Excel. Unsaved workbooks may prompt; suppressing alerts may discard them. Quit only the instance owned by the current operation.

title: Application.EnableEvents
summary: Controls Excel application events. Preserve the previous value; do not assume it was True on entry.

title: Workbook.SaveCopyAs
summary: Writes a copy without changing the open workbook in memory. It does not itself create a transactional rollback strategy.

title: Option Explicit statement
summary: Requires variable declarations and surfaces undeclared names at compile time. It does not replace explicit typing or business validation.

title: IIf function
summary: Evaluates both result expressions. Use an If block when a branch could fail or have side effects.

title: Dim statement
summary: Declares variables and arrays. WithEvents belongs in class modules, cannot form an array and cannot be combined with New.

title: Sub statement
summary: Declares procedures and parameters. VBA defaults to ByRef, unlike VB.NET. Specify parameter intent explicitly.

title: DoEvents function
summary: Yields to the operating system to process queued events. Guard against re-entry; it does not turn VBA into a background worker.

title: Data type summary
summary: Summarizes VBA storage and ranges: Integer is 16-bit, Long 32-bit, Currency is scaled integer, and Double uses floating point.

title: Collection object
summary: Ordered group with Add, Item, Remove and Count. Do not assume it offers Dictionary.Exists.

title: Dictionary object
summary: Key/item container with Exists, Keys, Items and CompareMode. Availability of the scripting component is a deployment dependency.

title: GetActiveWindow (Win32)
summary: Returns an HWND for the calling thread or NULL, not necessarily the foreground window of another process.

title: Sleep (Win32)
summary: Suspends the current thread; its milliseconds parameter is DWORD, not a pointer. Sleeping on the UI thread is not a responsiveness solution.

title: pywin32 client source
summary: Primary implementation distinguishes GetActiveObject, Dispatch and DispatchEx. DispatchEx creates via CoCreateInstanceEx. Verify instance ownership rather than relying on generic Dispatch.
